title: Degree-90 packed Round-2 tail
objective: Extend the exact proof-carrying packed Round-2 terminal state safely through degree 90, profile the degree-90 public tail, and reduce its native batch below five seconds when attainable while preserving exact generic equality and lifecycle safety

oracles: forced generic FLINT order payload equality
exceptions: Extends the existing FLINT host adapter and packed fmpz representation primitive; no mathematical algorithm is selected by function name and exact generic FLINT remains the tested capability fallback.

handoff.summary: Independent immutable-source p-maximal solves now cover degrees 64 through 96 with a deterministic RSS-bounded pthread schedule and exact sequential non-pthread fallback. Pairwise-coprime local orders are combined as scaled generators in the shared power basis. Equation-order containment supplies the exact largest-elementary-divisor bound for FLINT modular row HNF. Degree90's 18-prime batch is 4.55s and byte-identical to forced generic HNF; vector429's degree64 p=2,3,5 production boundary is 1.85s and byte-identical to the compounded sequential result.
risks: The fresh degree90 public path still exceeded 120 seconds after the native tail was reduced to 4.55 seconds. The censored diagnostic emitted no stage marker, so the remaining downstream merge/materialization/certification stage must be isolated with an externally bounded marker-emitting probe.
Native Windows FLINT intentionally uses the exact one-lane fallback because FLINT_USES_PTHREAD is false; it has correctness coverage but not the pthread performance capability.
Current performance receipts are Linux x64. Linux arm64, macOS arm64, and native Windows x64 remain integration CI requirements.
next_steps: Integrate commit 11bf5fd05ef81a61f3686d51ff0735fa135abb2f and the final receipt follow-up.
Profile the degree90 public path with an external process-group timeout and streaming stage markers to locate the downstream >120-second residual without repeating native work.
Run the registered focused normal/sanitized witness and architecture checks at final integration, then exercise the non-pthread fallback on native Windows CI.
